decorations.description: Decorations grant houseBonusScaled / decorationBonus inside influenceRadiusTiles (edge-to-edge). Applies to houses and commerces. 100 scaled ~= +1%.

wonders.description: cityBonusScaled / rewardBonusScaled: global city bonus to houses and commerces (accumulates, no radius). 500 ~= +5%. Each wonder also produces goldReward / diamondReward every goldIntervalSec / diamondIntervalSec (7 days).

formulas.collect: grant goldReward and/or diamondReward when timers ready
formulas.cityBonus: added into influenceScaled for every house and commerce

commerce.description: Commerces earn rentPerTenant × customers (people in finished houses inside influenceRadiusTiles) every COMMERCE_CYCLE_SEC (3 min), then decoration/wonder influence.

formulas.customers: sum(house.runtime.people) for finished houses in radius

rent.description: Houses earn rent via signed contracts. Sign (pay costBase) → wait → collect incomeBase boosted by house contractBonusPercent and decoration/wonder influence.
